locate_passage:r04.text: Volunteers tend to exit once they no longer experience the work as theirs.

locate_passage:r05.text: Programs that cut orientation to a single session saw retention fall by 42% within a year.

locate_passage:r06.text: Volunteers who received a written description of their role remained active longer than volunteers who received only a verbal briefing.

locate_passage:r08.text: Recognition events had no measurable effect on exit among long-serving volunteers.
